content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the local currency collapsed and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-digital-products-3|The Real]]-actually-2|financial]] isolation loomed, the pressure-tested infrastructure of COREMERCH emerged, empowering digital creators to sell online without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe, Gumroad, or PayPal. The sovereign commerce infrastructure company designs, documents, and deploys digital commerce stacks that give creators full control over their online stores, automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and data ownership. This post breaks down Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, a critical component of COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script (GAS) is a serverless, JavaScript-based platform that automates tasks, integrates data, and triggers actions within a Google Sheets or Google Drive environment. In the context of digital commerce, GAS enables the automation of order fulfillment, automated delivery of digital products, and seamless integration with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments. This setup frees digital creators from the constraints of traditional e-commerce platforms, allowing them to focus on their products and audience, while maintaining full control over their online presence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

When a customer places an order, the payment processor, NOWPayments, sends a webhook notification to the Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend. This backend verifies the payment, checks the order status, and triggers the automated fulfillment process. The Supabase or Google Sheets database stores the order information, and the Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 storage delivers the digital product. This architecture ensures that orders are processed in under 30 seconds, providing a seamless and efficient customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) cater to digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted or unavailable. These creators can now sell digital products online, such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, using a fully sovereign, automated, and scalable infrastructure. By leveraging Google Apps Script, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Workers, creators can maintain full control over their online presence, automate order fulfillment, and deliver digital products instantly.
Automating order fulfillment using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers ensures a seamless customer experience and reduces manual errors.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This combination of tools enables the automation of order fulfillment, seamless integration with crypto payment processors, and full data ownership for digital creators. By deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can ensure that their online store is fully sovereign, automated, and scalable.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: Start by signing up for the COREMERCH website and selecting the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). Next, set up your Google Apps Script project, connect it to your Supabase or Google Sheets database, and configure the Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and deliver digital products using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. By following these steps, digital creators can deploy a fully sovereign, automated, and scalable digital commerce infrastructure within 48 hours.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) integrates with NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors.

What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is an HTTP callback that notifies the backend of a specific event, such as a payment confirmation. In the context of digital commerce, webhooks trigger the automated fulfillment process, which includes verifying the payment, checking the order status, and delivering the digital product. The Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend handles the webhook notification and triggers the subsequent actions.
